follow: Follow the Mac's view and theme
localOnly: Your choices affect this screen. Sound stays on your Mac.
installLocal: Use your browser's Add to Home Screen option if available. Full PWA installation needs HTTPS; this local HTTP viewer works in your browser.
installSecure: Use your browser's Add to Home Screen or Install option. Your Mac must stay awake with Phone display enabled.
pairMessage: Enable Phone display in Sillage Settings, then scan its QR code. Keep both devices on the same Wi-Fi network.
expiredMessage: Sharing has restarted or this link has expired. Open Phone display on your Mac and scan its current QR code.
offlineMessage: Keep Sillage open, Phone display enabled, and both devices on the same local network. Reconnection is automatic.
busyMessage: Up to four screens can connect at once. Close another viewer and retry.
